inspection_method.sample_basis: Full verified Stage-1 tranche; field-level inspection of all 1,200 persisted/read-back nodes.
inspection_method.limitation: The tranche contains places/entities, not 1,200 independently verified operating businesses. Website/domain/locality fields were inspected exactly; no industry-label inference was used.
inspection_method.unsupported_cases_rule: Lifecycle status, ownership, buyer identity and current commercial intent remain UNKNOWN unless separately verified from a current authoritative source.

clusters.repeated_observable_problem: Every inspected node lacks a first-party website and normalized domain, so the tranche cannot directly resolve an official digital presence or buyer/contact route.
clusters.confidence_evidence_strength: HIGH — exact null-field count across all 12 persisted partitions; Stage-1 receipt independently reports website_domain_bearing_count=0.
clusters.geographic_category_spread: 48 countries / 50 categories in the full tranche.
clusters.amx_solution_capability_match: AMX research, entity resolution, structured comparison, validation/provenance and evidence hashing can produce a verified official-domain/contact enrichment layer.
clusters.smallest_bounded_deliverable: Verified enrichment pilot for 100 tranche nodes: official website/domain, entity status, official contact route where public, source URL, observed_at, confidence and exception reason.
clusters.dependency_state: EXECUTABLE_FOR_PILOT_BUILD; EXTERNAL TEST REQUIRES VERIFIED RECIPIENT/ROUTE
clusters.effort_time_to_deliver: Estimated 4–8 focused worker-hours for a 100-node pilot; estimate not yet benchmarked.
clusters.likely_buyer_reachability_route: Dataset/travel-content operator or venue-data maintainer; verify Audiala repository owner/issue/contact route and dedupe prior AMX contact history. Secondary route: official venue operators after enrichment resolves first-party contacts.

proposed_bounded_offer.offer: 100-record verified official-presence and contact-route enrichment pilot
proposed_bounded_offer.price: NOT_QUOTED — no buyer-specific pricing evidence yet

clusters.falsifier_kill_condition: Kill or reframe if a current first-party field exists elsewhere in the source schema for >=80% of inspected nodes, or reachable buyers state the field has no operational value.
clusters.exact_next_commercial_action: Select for Stage 3; enrich a risk-balanced 20-node test subset, verify 5–10 lawful public recipient routes, then PRI tests one concise offer structure with factual node-specific evidence.

clusters.repeated_observable_problem: Every inspected node has locality=null even though many source_page paths encode a locality-like segment; this blocks clean geographic grouping, routing and localized offer generation.
clusters.confidence_evidence_strength: HIGH for missing locality; MEDIUM for recoverability because URL segments require validation.
clusters.amx_solution_capability_match: AMX data cleanup, transformation, validation and provenance tooling can backfill normalized locality plus confidence/exception metadata.
clusters.smallest_bounded_deliverable: 100-record locality normalization and validation pilot with before/after values, evidence, confidence and exceptions.
clusters.dependency_state: EXECUTABLE_FOR_DATA_PILOT; COMMERCIAL TEST DEPENDS ON VERIFIED BUYER ROUTE
clusters.effort_time_to_deliver: Estimated 2–4 focused worker-hours for 100 records; estimate not yet benchmarked.
clusters.likely_buyer_reachability_route: Same operator/data-maintainer lane as Cluster 001; bundle only if buyer confirms locality completeness matters.

proposed_bounded_offer.price: NOT_QUOTED — no buyer-specific pricing evidence yet

clusters.falsifier_kill_condition: Kill if locality is intentionally omitted by schema design or operator confirms URL geography satisfies downstream needs.
clusters.exact_next_commercial_action: Retain as add-on to Cluster 001; validate operator need before presenting.

unsupported_uncertain_cases.reason: The tranche includes apparent future/historic/possibly closed entities, but a recurring lifecycle-error rate has not yet been measured against current authoritative sources.
unsupported_uncertain_cases.next_verification: Validate a risk-stratified subset against current primary sources before assigning a frequency or commercial offer.

stage_2_acceptance.rationale: A durable frequency table from the exact verified 1,200-node FORX tranche contains an executable recurring cluster: 1,200/1,200 nodes lack first-party website/domain resolution, with tools and a smallest bounded pilot defined.
